description: This file contains utility functions for fusing convolutional and linear modules with batch normalization modules in PyTorch. The functions facilitate model optimization by combining layers for more efficient inference.

methods.name: ConvT fuse_conv_bn_eval( conv: ConvT, bn: torch.nn.modules.batchnorm._BatchNorm, transpose: bool = False, )
methods.description: Fuses a convolutional module and a BatchNorm module into a single convolutional module, used for inference optimization.

methods.name: tuple[torch.nn.Parameter,torch.nn.Parameter] fuse_conv_bn_weights( conv_w: torch.Tensor, conv_b: torch.Tensor | None, bn_rm: torch.Tensor, bn_rv: torch.Tensor, bn_eps: float, bn_w: torch.Tensor | None, bn_b: torch.Tensor | None, transpose: bool = False, )
methods.description: Calculates new convolutional weights and biases by fusing with BatchNorm parameters.

methods.name: LinearT fuse_linear_bn_eval( linear: LinearT, bn: torch.nn.modules.batchnorm._BatchNorm, )
methods.description: Fuses a linear module and a BatchNorm module into a single linear module for inference.

methods.name: tuple[torch.nn.Parameter,torch.nn.Parameter] fuse_linear_bn_weights( linear_w: torch.Tensor, linear_b: torch.Tensor | None, bn_rm: torch.Tensor, bn_rv: torch.Tensor, bn_eps: float, bn_w: torch.Tensor, bn_b: torch.Tensor, )
methods.description: Computes new linear layer weights and biases after fusing with BatchNorm parameters.
